# Health Check Script
# Checks if services are running on specified ports

set -e

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'

    else

    fi
}

echo "======================================"

echo ""

    if ! check_port "$port"; then
        all_healthy=false
    fi
done

    echo -e "Overall Status: ${GREEN}ALL SERVICES HEALTHY${NC}"
    exit 0

fi
